volcanite_portable_battery.description: Portable RF storage with 500,000 RF capacity.

advanced_volcanite_portable_battery.description: Advanced portable RF storage with 5,000,000 RF capacity.

volcanite_energy_cell.description: Basic block energy storage; also a valid Energy Matrix ring component.

volcanite_energy_unit.description: Advanced block energy storage; also a valid Energy Matrix ring component.

volcanite_energy_core.description: Controller of the flat 3×3 Energy Matrix.

keraunos_hv_core.description: Controller of the 3×3×3 Keraunos high-voltage matrix.

keraunos_hv_port.description: Network access port for the Keraunos high-voltage structure.

astrape_energy_pylon.description: Wireless RF infrastructure. Configure supported pylon links with the Supreme Link Tool.

volcanite_wrench.description: Configures supported pipes and machines, cycles conduit faces and assembles supported multiblocks. Sneak behavior depends on the target block.

supreme_link_tool.description: Links supported network nodes, Astrape Pylons and teleporter pads.

hv_dielectric_hot_stick.description: A dielectric tool for high-voltage system operations.

hephaestean_resonator.description: An RF-powered scanning tool with ore and waypoint modes.

pipe_facade.description: A facade used to disguise compatible pipe infrastructure.

volcanite_blueprint.description: Encodes crafting patterns for compatible crafting infrastructure.

hermes_filter_blueprint.description: A blueprint for compatible item-filter configuration.

volcanite_logistics_module.description: A configurable export/import controller mounted on supported pipes, wires or adjacent containers.

volcanite_import_connector.description: Import connector for compatible cable and storage infrastructure.

volcanite_export_connector.description: Export connector for compatible cable and storage infrastructure.

volcanite_advanced_filter_module.description: Advanced filtering module for compatible storage or transport systems.

hermes_filter_upgrade.description: Filtering upgrade for compatible Hermes item transport.

volcanite_overclock_upgrade.description: Basic overclock upgrade. Increases processing speed and energy demand on compatible machines.

advanced_volcanite_overclock_upgrade.description: Advanced overclock upgrade. Increases processing speed and energy demand on compatible machines.

supreme_volcanite_overclock_upgrade.description: Supreme overclock upgrade. Increases processing speed and energy demand on compatible machines.

volcanite_basic_pipe_energy_upgrade.description: Basic transfer upgrade for compatible pipe/conduit faces; inspect the target configuration for supported channels and limits.

volcanite_advanced_pipe_energy_upgrade.description: Advanced transfer upgrade for compatible pipe/conduit faces; inspect the target configuration for supported channels and limits.

volcanite_supreme_pipe_energy_upgrade.description: Supreme transfer upgrade for compatible pipe/conduit faces; inspect the target configuration for supported channels and limits.

quantum_link_module.description: Links supported storage blocks to Quantum storage; follow the target block’s installation conditions.

volcanite_compactor_upgrade.description: Compacts matching resources in compatible storage.

volcanite_void_upgrade.description: Overflow-voiding upgrade; review settings before enabling it.

volcanite_filtered_void_upgrade.description: Filtered voiding upgrade; matching items may be discarded.

volcanite_barrel_void_upgrade.description: Voids excess items in a compatible bulk-storage barrel.
